items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Russell Procope and Sonny Greer are playing downtown in some place. I've been intending to go by there whenever they are in the club, night club.

ctx.x: Where did the rest of the people in Lurceford's your band, in Lunsford's band, did many of the other band members go to hear Ellington's band when he came to Buffalo?

Oh, yeah, the ones that were in there. Oh, that was -- Ellington was Ellington then and still is. Of course, I don't know what kind of band he assemble now. Russell Procope and Sonny Greer are playing downtown in some place. I've been intending to go by there whenever they are in the club, night club.

Yes, I used to do a solo, drum solo on numbers like -- like Caravan and other numbers like that, but I had some worked out, hopping from Joe Jones to Big Sid, people like that. I had some worked out, and it was very interesting to see, because I had my wheels turning on my fingers also, you know, the drumsticks, throwing them in the air, catching them this way, behind me, and I had me a little act going.
